subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than so
guide_solution: Summary Change is the law of nature which happens in all walks of life. Monitory and stagnation make our life distasteful and meaningless whereas change makes our life livable, romantic, desirable and meaningful. The history of human civilization sees a constant change. All kinds of change whether violent or smooth have taken place with dangers and difficulties, odds and disadvantage but the law of life and nature continue working. And finally with passage of 178 time a new ideas and new values of life emerge out of debris of the old. অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Barisal Cadet College. Sl. No. 12; Page No. 57
